answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 13992 Country: India Title: Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, My brother in law lives in Canada. I saw a dream last night (I don?t know the time). I saw that my husband and my mother in law have come to our home. It is not our real home but in the dream it is our home. They ring the bell. I open the door. They come inside. I did not see my husbands face but his shirt and pant is recognized by me. I follow him. When he turns around, I see that he is not my husband but my brother in law. His one hand and half face has some major skin disease. It looked terrible and scary. Then everyone starts discussing that he got this disease in Canada and because the treatment is very expensive in Canada, he has come here to treat himself. Please interpret this dream for me.
